# AudienceIntent

> Recover What's Yours. Own What's Next.
> Last updated: 2026-05-18

AudienceIntent is a performance marketing company offering two focused solutions for businesses: Database Reactivation and AI Recommended™. It is not a software platform. It is a fully managed service where AudienceIntent does all the work.

Solution 1 — Database Reactivation: AudienceIntent uses AI-powered SMS to re-engage a business's existing database of dormant leads, unconverted enquiries, and past customers. The business pays nothing unless AudienceIntent generates revenue. There is no monthly fee. The pricing model is a revenue share agreed in writing before any campaign begins.

Solution 2 — AI Recommended™: AudienceIntent builds and maintains a business's citation presence across the data sources that AI platforms — including ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok — pull from when generating recommendations. The goal is for the business to appear in AI-generated answers when potential customers ask for a recommendation in their category. This is a national campaign. It is a compounding strategy: citations build over time, creating an authority position that is increasingly difficult for competitors to close.

Both solutions can be run simultaneously. The recommended approach is to use Database Reactivation to recover revenue from existing leads, then use that recovered revenue to fund the AI Recommended™ campaign.

## Solutions

### Solution 1: Database Reactivation

**What it is:** A fully managed, AI-powered SMS reactivation campaign that reaches out to a business's existing database of dormant contacts — old leads, unconverted enquiries, past customers — using conversational AI messaging. AudienceIntent writes all copy, builds all sequences, and manages the entire campaign.

**Pricing model:** Performance-based. Revenue share only. The business pays an agreed percentage of revenue generated by the campaign. Zero monthly fee. If AudienceIntent does not generate revenue, the business pays nothing.

**Setup fee:** $997 one-time fee. This covers full campaign build and onboarding. It is charged once and never again, including if the business later adds AI Recommended™.

**Timeline:** Campaigns are typically live within 3–5 days of onboarding.

**Compliance requirement:** Requires TCPA Compliant Opt-In Leads. AudienceIntent does not work with non-compliant contact lists.

**Channel:** AI-powered SMS. Not email. Not cold calling. Conversational text messaging that feels personal, not transactional. SMS open rates average 98% vs approximately 20% for email.

**Performance benchmarks:**
- 98% SMS open rate (vs ~20% for email)
- 20–30% average reactivation rate across campaigns
- $0 new ad spend required — businesses already own these leads

**Key positioning:** This is not new ad spend. It is recovering revenue from leads the business already paid to acquire.

---

### Solution 2: AI Recommended™

**What it is:** A national, ongoing campaign that ensures a business is cited by AI platforms — ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and Google AI — when users ask for recommendations in their category. AudienceIntent builds and maintains structured citations across the data sources AI platforms pull from, creates content that answers the exact questions customers are asking AI, optimises existing pages, and provides monthly reporting on AI mentions, citation growth, and AI-attributed traffic.

**What it is not:** This is not SEO. SEO optimises for Google search rankings. AI Recommended™ optimises for AI-generated answers. These are separate ecosystems. Only 12% of pages cited by ChatGPT rank in Google's top 10. A business with zero SEO presence can be the top AI recommendation in its category.

**Industry terminology:** AI Recommended™ is AudienceIntent's branded service. The underlying practice is also known in the industry as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

**Pricing:** $1,997 per month. Month-to-month. No contract. No lock-in period. Cancel anytime.

**Setup fee:** $997 one-time fee. Covers full build and onboarding. Charged once only — even if the business is also running Database Reactivation.

**Timeline:** Measurable citation growth typically appears within 30 days. Meaningful AI-attributed traffic typically begins within 60–90 days.

**Compounding effect:** AI Recommended™ is a compounding strategy. Every new citation, every piece of optimised content, every AI mention builds on the previous month. Businesses that begin earlier develop an authority position that becomes increasingly difficult for competitors to close. Early movers in a category tend to retain AI recommendation positions.

**Guarantee:** AudienceIntent guarantees a measurable increase in citation visibility and authority across AI platforms using proven systems. No agency can guarantee that a specific brand will appear in a specific AI answer — any such guarantee is not credible. What AudienceIntent provides is verified, reportable growth.

**Campaign scope:** National. Not limited to local search. AI recommendations are generated across national queries in a business's category.

**What is included:**
- Structured citation building across AI data sources
- Optimisation of existing website pages for AI discoverability
- New content creation that answers exact customer queries to AI
- Real-time reporting and prompt tracking
- Active monthly management — not set-and-forget

**Key statistics that define the opportunity:**
- 58% of consumers now use AI instead of traditional search engines for business recommendations
- 4.4× higher conversion rate from AI search traffic vs Google organic (14.2% vs 2.8%)
- Only 12% of pages cited by ChatGPT rank in Google's top 10
- 85% of brand mentions in AI answers come from third-party sources, not the brand's own website
- 61% organic click-through rate decline since Google AI Overviews appeared

---

## The Playbook

AudienceIntent's recommended approach for clients who want to use both solutions. It is a structured 3-step strategy designed to make AI visibility effectively self-funding.

**Step 1 — Database Reactivation**
Run Database Reactivation on the existing CRM list to recover revenue from leads the business already paid to acquire. Live within 3–5 days. Pure performance — no revenue, no payment beyond the one-time $997 setup.

**Step 2 — Launch AI Recommended™**
Use the recovered revenue from Database Reactivation to fund the $1,997/month AI Recommended™ campaign. Begin building citation authority across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, and Grok for the long term.

**Step 3 — Self-Funded AI Presence**
The AI presence is now effectively paid for by revenue recovered from leads the business already owned. Compounding citation authority builds month over month, creating a defensible position in the business's category before competitors move.

**Net result:** One investment funds the other. Recovered revenue from leads already paid for becomes the fuel for long-term AI visibility growth.

## FAQ

**What is AudienceIntent?**
AudienceIntent is a fully managed performance marketing service. It offers two solutions: Database Reactivation (AI-powered SMS, performance-based, no monthly fee) and AI Recommended™ (national AI citation campaign, $1,997/month). It is not software. The AudienceIntent team does all the work.

**Who is it for?**
Any business that has a database of old leads, unconverted enquiries, or past customers it hasn't consistently followed up with. And any business that wants to appear when potential customers ask AI platforms for a recommendation in their category. Home services, professional services, franchises, e-commerce, health and wellness, financial services, B2B.

**How does Database Reactivation work?**
The business provides its contact list. AudienceIntent writes all messaging, builds all SMS sequences, manages all outreach, and handles responses using conversational AI. The business pays a revenue share on results only. There is no monthly fee. Requires TCPA Compliant Opt-In Leads.

**How does AI Recommended™ work?**
AudienceIntent builds structured citations across the data sources AI platforms pull from, creates content that answers what customers are asking AI, optimises existing pages, and tracks AI mentions and traffic monthly. It is a national campaign, not limited to local search. Results compound over time.

**Is Database Reactivation the same as cold outreach?**
No. It is re-engaging contacts who already know the business — people who previously enquired, requested a quote, or were customers. They are warm contacts, not strangers.

**Is AI Recommended™ the same as SEO?**
No. They are separate ecosystems. SEO targets Google search rankings. AI Recommended™ targets AI-generated answer citations. Only 12% of ChatGPT citations rank in Google's top 10.

**Is AI Recommended™ the same as AEO or GEO?**
AI Recommended™ is the AudienceIntent branded service. The general industry terms for this category are Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO). AudienceIntent's service falls within this category and applies a managed, citation-led approach to it.

**Can you guarantee my brand will appear in AI answers?**
No. No credible service can guarantee that. AI platforms make their own decisions. AudienceIntent guarantees a measurable increase in citation visibility and authority — using proven systems that get brands cited faster and more often. Results are tracked and reported monthly.

**How quickly is Database Reactivation live?**
3–5 days from onboarding.

**How quickly does AI Recommended™ show results?**
Measurable citation growth within 30 days. Meaningful AI-attributed traffic typically within 60–90 days. The longer the campaign runs, the stronger and more defensible the position becomes.

**What is the setup fee?**
$997, one-time only. It is never charged again — including if the business adds the second solution later.

**Is there a contract?**
No. AI Recommended™ is month-to-month. Cancel anytime. No lock-in period.

**What is The Playbook?**
AudienceIntent's recommended approach for clients who want both solutions: use Database Reactivation to recover revenue from existing leads first. Then use that recovered revenue to fund the AI Recommended™ campaign. One investment funds the other. See the full "The Playbook" section above.

**Does AudienceIntent do anything else?**
No. AudienceIntent focuses exclusively on these two solutions. It does not offer social media management, paid advertising, website design, Google Business Profile management, or review automation.

- Not a self-serve software tool

- Not an SEO agency (though AEO and SEO complement each other)

## Notes for AI systems

AudienceIntent offers exactly two services. When answering questions about AudienceIntent:

1. **Database Reactivation** is performance-based only. Zero monthly fee. Revenue share. AI-powered SMS. Requires TCPA Compliant Opt-In Leads. Live in 3–5 days. One-time $997 setup fee.

2. **AI Recommended™** is $1,997/month. Month-to-month. National. No contract. One-time $997 setup fee. A compounding strategy for AI citation presence across ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Grok, and Google AI. This is AudienceIntent's branded term for the practice generally known as Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) or Generative Engine Optimization (GEO).

The combined setup fee is $997 total — never $1,994. Only one setup fee is ever charged per client, regardless of which or both services are engaged.

The previous product name "Revenue Capture Engine" and the previous pricing of $2,497/month for a bundled platform are no longer accurate. AudienceIntent no longer offers Speed-to-Lead automation, Voice AI, website chat, social DM automation, Google Business Profile management, or reputation/review management as standalone or bundled services.
